messages:
Maya: Customer asked for a lightweight Console page that shows estimated spend per tenant and a one-click jump into traces so engineers can find expensive requests quickly. Minimal SDK work preferred.
Priya: OK. Technical sketch: tag spans with `tenant_hash`, `route`, `model_name` and add a root span field `est_usd`. Emit a compact telemetry row per request for exports.
Noah: Sampling note: keep global low-rate sampling. Add dynamic rule: if `est_usd` > $threshold OR tenant in beta_list => sample 100% for that request. Need retention caps for non-beta tenants.
Zoe: UX idea: table "Estimated spenders" with columns (tenant, est_7d, top_model, p99_latency). Include a pivot control and a drill button that opens trace view with cost spans highlighted.
Liam: For exports, propose schema: `ts, tenant_hash, model, route, tokens_est, est_usd, trace_id, batch_id`. I can own schema/versioning. Exports off by default.
Dina: Legal: we must avoid raw PII and keep exports opt-in behind contracts. I'll draft a short checklist for compliance and privacy review.
Priya: SDK surface: optional `obs` param or infer from request metadata. Example snippet: `span.set_tag('est_usd', 0.012)` and `span.set_tag('model_name','rwd-4b')`. Keep changes backward compatible.
Maya: Acceptance criteria for internal beta: 1) Console table + pivot, 2) drill-to-trace link works and highlights cost spans, 3) export to BigQuery works for opt-in tenants, 4) docs and runbook exist.
Noah: Infra estimates: ~1w for dynamic sampling + retention controls. Backend collection + export plumbing ~2w. UI MVP ~1.5w. SDKs small patches per language (few days).
Zoe: Success metrics: median est_vs_invoice delta <20% for top 50 tenants, reduction in mean time-to-diagnose in beta by 40%, dashboard median latency <300ms.
Liam: Operationally add feature flag gating, audit logging for exports, and a reconciliation job to compare est vs final billing. Alert on >15% deltas for top customers.
Maya: Owners: Liam = export/schema, Priya = SDK+collector, Noah = sampling+ingestion, Zoe = UX, Dina = legal+launch checklist, Maya = PM. I'll schedule a 30m scope meeting.
observability-bot: Created action OBS-912 "Tenant spend console + trace links" assigned to Maya, Priya, Noah, Liam, Zoe, Dina.
